slides.heading: What a pro would do that you didn't ask for
paras: Treat the leak as a specimen to measure, not a template. Assume your own prompt will leak, as Claude Code's did three times (2025-02-24, March 2026, and v2.1.88 on 2026-03-31), so no secret or authorization logic lives in prose.
